mentions.name: Personal journal app
mentions.description: This app is a personal journal similar to Diarium, built to add features missing from Diarium and Day One. It includes a distraction-free "writing" mode that hides everything but the words, improved voice-to-text transcription that can be pasted into the entry body while keeping the recording, better picture layouts, and Apple Watch integration for speaking entries on the go. It is designed to make integrating new features easy.
mentions.problem: Existing journal apps Diarium and Day One lack features the author wants, such as a writing mode, better transcription, and Apple Watch support.
mentions.source_excerpt: Been working on my version of a journal app that is basically Diarium but I can add any features that are missing from Diarium and Day One.
mentions.author: hyraki
